name: How long does it take to see results from AEO efforts for an optometrist?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO efforts for an optometrist?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see results from AEO efforts for an optometrist can vary, but initial improvements in visibility, such as securing featured snippets or direct answers, might be observed within a few weeks to a few months. Achieving sustained and significant impact on patient acquisition typically takes longer, often 3 to 6 months or more, as search engines re-index content and establish your practice's authority. Continuous monitoring and refinement are crucial for long-term success, as search algorithms and patient queries evolve.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial AEO results may appear in weeks to months, with significant patient acquisition impact typically taking 3-6 months or more, requiring continuous monitoring.
